form.provisioningTimeNote: The first registration on this Hub can take around 30 seconds.
form.advancedSummary: Specify the engine binding manually (advanced) | only when reusing an existing Hub workspace
form.engineCredentialRefHint: This is a reference NAME, not the secret itself (the secret is resolved on the engine side).
form.credentialLooksReal: This looks like a real secret (sk_/apikey_ prefix) — enter the reference name instead.
form.engineTripleRequired: Auto-registration is unavailable right now: all three engine fields are required — fill them in, or choose "No engine".
form.engineTriplePartial: The three engine binding fields must be all filled or all blank — a partial fill cannot be created.
form.bindingDuplicate: This resource is already in the list.
form.targetEmpty: You have no topic / board / doc space you can bind.
form.targetEmptyHint: A binding is also this project's permission source — only resources you can read can be bound.
form.targetCapNote: Only the first 100 candidates are listed (known limitation).

createError.slugTaken: That slug is already taken — pick another one.
createError.targetForbidden: You do not have read access to this resource.
createError.engineField: The engine binding is incomplete: fill all three fields, or leave all three blank to auto-register.
createError.provisionUnavailable: Auto-registration is temporarily unavailable (the Hub was never reached) and nothing was saved — keep the slug and project name as they are and try again.
createError.provisionTimeout: Registering with the Hub timed out and it may already have landed. Keep the slug and project name unchanged and try again (the Hub replays it by idempotency key).
createError.provisionConflict: The Hub refused the registration with a conflict: this slug may already exist in a different shape. Pick another slug, or fill in the existing engine binding explicitly in the advanced section.
createError.provisionFailed: Registration failed on the Hub side. Fill in the engine binding explicitly in the advanced section to bypass auto-registration, or fix the reported cause and retry.

project.refreshFailedAfterCreate: The project was created, but refreshing the project list failed — reload the page and select it manually.

reason.notConfigured: This deployment has no memory engine configured. Memory is optional: the ledger below still works, only search needs the engine.
reason.projectUnbound: This project has no engine bound. Its ledger still works; an admin has to bind an engine before search can run.
reason.engineUnavailable: The memory engine is temporarily unavailable. The ledger below still works; try search again later.

engine.runtimeNote: The last search hit the engine while it was unavailable — search stays disabled until it answers again.

hint.active: This is the claim currently in effect.
hint.superseded: A correction replaced this claim — it is kept for the record.
hint.withdrawn: This correction was withdrawn and never became an in-effect claim.

card.excerptEmpty: No excerpt was stored for this entry.

nominator.label: Nominator
nominator.deletedHint: This nominator's account has been deleted — the name is kept from their profile.
nominator.orphanHint: This nominator's profile can no longer be resolved — showing the first 8 characters of the id.

search.semanticNote: Asks the engine — up to {max} results, and every run spends engine quota.
search.literalNote: Matches text across the {count} entries already loaded here — instant, and spends no quota.
search.restoredHint: A previous query was restored into the box. Press Search to run it again — opening a shared link never spends quota on its own.
search.forbidden: You can read this project's ledger metadata, but not the content of its memories — semantic search needs content access.
search.literalEmpty: Nothing in the loaded entries matches “{query}”.
search.orderNote: Ranking and scores come from the engine: the number is a lexical-matching weight for this one search only (not comparable across searches or projects), and it is not a confidence score — a higher number does not mean more likely to be true.
search.trustNote: This is what the engine associates by meaning, not a conclusion. The body is a snapshot from when it was formed, and its sources may have changed since.
search.filteredByPermission: Some entries were withheld because their sources are not visible to you.
search.engineDataSuspect: The engine returned entries this project cannot map to a ledger row — treat them with caution.

empty.noMatches: The engine found nothing for that wording. Try asking it differently — or this project may not remember anything about it yet.
empty.allFiltered: The engine did find matches, but every one of them was filtered out because you lack access to its sources. Request access to those sources to see them.

search.staleResults: This refresh did not go through — the results below are from the previous run and may be out of date.

empty.committedTitle: It has not remembered anything yet
empty.committedDesc: Memories are formed by the engine after an agent nominates a claim.
empty.committedRoadmap: There are {count} nominations still in flight — open the Nominations tab to follow them.
empty.nominationsDesc: Nominations land here while the engine is still working on them, or when a run failed and needs another look.
empty.inactiveDesc: Entries move here once a correction replaces them, or when a correction attempt is withdrawn.

memory.listError: Failed to load the memory ledger

degraded.pageBanner: You can see this project's ledger metadata, but not the content of its memories. Everything below is the metadata projection — ask for content access to read claims, excerpts and sources.
degraded.rowLockedHint: This entry's sources are no longer visible to you, so its body was withheld.

recovery.label: Next step
recovery.sameKeyResend: Still in flight — it can be resumed with the same idempotency key.
recovery.inspectBackfill: Backfilled from a read-only inspection of the engine.
recovery.hubManualRequired: The engine rejected this, or its outcome is unknown — an operator has to step in.
recovery.configInvalid: This project's engine binding or credentials are invalid; retrying will not help.
recovery.paramInvalid: The request parameters were rejected — resubmit with a new idempotency key.
recovery.unknown: No next step was recorded for this row.

detail.notFound: This ledger row is not visible
detail.notFoundDesc: It may have been removed, or it may belong to a project you cannot read.
detail.errorTitle: Failed to load this ledger row
detail.metadataOnlyDesc: You can see this ledger row's metadata, but not its content. Content access to this project is required to read the claim, its rationale and its sources.
detail.noContent: No content was stored for this row.
detail.subject: Subject
detail.sourcesEmpty: No sources — this claim was authored, not sourced.
detail.sourceMoved: changed since this memory was formed
detail.noEngineMemory: An engine memory appears only after a correction or a nomination has been formed — this row does not have one yet.
detail.noEngineMemoryMetadata: This row is a metadata-only projection — its engine projection needs the same content read access, so it is hidden too.
detail.engineViewUnavailable: This memory's engine projection is not readable right now.

timeline.title: Correction chain
timeline.unavailable: The correction chain could not be loaded — the row above is still shown as fetched.
timeline.chainIncomplete: This chain may be incomplete — the project has more than {cap} pages of ledger rows.
timeline.outsideChain: This row is not part of the chain view shown below.
timeline.withdrawnHint: Withdrawn corrections stay visible for the audit trail, but they never became an in-effect claim.

usage.openTitle: Open this project's recorded model usage

graph.title: Memory graph
graph.description: Nodes and relations as the engine sees them. The graph only shows engine-side memories — ledger rows that have no engine memory yet do not appear here.
graph.openTitle: See this project's memories as a graph (needs an ≥xl viewport)
graph.narrowTitle: Not enough width for the graph
graph.narrowDesc: The memory graph needs an ≥xl viewport (this version has no narrow-screen graph). Open a wider window, or go back to the ledger.
graph.errorTitle: The graph could not be loaded
graph.unavailableTitle: This project's graph is not readable
graph.unavailableDesc: Reading it needs content read access to this project, or the engine memories are currently all invisible.

canvas.noNodesDesc: This project has no engine memories yet. Memories are formed by the engine after an agent nominates them.
canvas.noEdgesNote: Edges come from corrections (supersedes) or engine relations; having no edge is normal.
canvas.hint: Scroll to zoom · drag to pan · click a node for details
canvas.roleStatus: Showing {nodes, plural, one {# node} other {# nodes}} / {edges, plural, one {# edge} other {# edges}}{truncated}

legend.title: Relation types
legend.arrowNote: Arrow points to the superseded version

governance.summary: Showing {nodes, plural, one {# node} other {# nodes}} · {edges, plural, one {# edge} other {# edges}}
governance.hiddenNodes: · {count, plural, one {# node hidden} other {# nodes hidden}} because a source is not visible
governance.omittedEdges: · {count, plural, one {# edge} other {# edges}} omitted
governance.omittedDetail: Omitted edges cover two cases: one endpoint still sits on a page that has not been loaded (loading more may fill it in), and endpoints that fall on different pages — browse only returns edges whose two endpoints are on the same page, so those will never be filled in by loading more. No edge on the graph does not mean no relation in the engine.
governance.scopeNote: The graph only shows engine-side memories; ledger rows that have no engine memory yet do not appear.
governance.permissionNote: Hidden nodes have two possible causes: the source's read permission is missing (ask the source's owner), or the source has been deleted (check the ledger). The engine's count does not separate them, so both are possible.
governance.suspectNote: The engine returned nodes that this project cannot map — treat them with care.
governance.truncatedNote: The engine truncated this page, so the graph may be incomplete.
governance.partialNote: The engine returned only part of the data, so the graph may be incomplete.

status.resetStale: The engine's data changed; the first page has been reloaded.
status.resetOther: The engine returned an error ({code}); the first page has been reloaded — you can retry later.
status.outOfView: {count, plural, one {# new node is} other {# new nodes are}} outside the view — use "Fit to view" at the bottom right to see them all.

resolution.mappedCount: This ledger row maps to {count} engine memories; the first one is shown here.

representations.subtitle: Older versions of this memory at one resolution
representations.emptyDesc: Older versions appear only when the same memory is re-formed at the same resolution. A correction does not produce one — it is a supersedes chain across memories (see the correction chain block below).
representations.bytes: {bytes, plural, one {# byte} other {# bytes}} original

dialog.unavailable: This memory's engine projection is not readable right now.
dialog.errorOther: The body could not be loaded.
dialog.bodyTruncated: The engine truncated this body ({bytes} bytes original).

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: Platform API/MCP call statistics and the model work recorded by a project's Hument engine identity. These are two separate ledgers — they are never summed together.
usage.platformDescription: Platform API and MCP call statistics.

platform.adminOnlyDesc: This view aggregates platform-wide API/MCP call statistics. Ask an admin if you need access.

table.caption: Top-N {groupBy} usage in the selected window

note.noTableData: No usage data exists in this deployment yet.
note.coverageWarn: Less than 28 days of data — do not read short-window differences as a trend.
note.topN: Top {limit} only — this is not a full total and must not be summed.
note.noSum: Top-N rows are ranked keys, not a complete partition; totals are intentionally not shown.
note.mixedUnits: Caller rows mix invocation rows and fan-out REST rows (different units). Use them for activity ranking only.
note.coverageUnknownWarn: Coverage is unknown — the “less than 28 days” warning cannot be ruled out.
note.ledgerScope: These are platform API/MCP call counts — a separate ledger from model usage and cost totals.

empty.noTableDataDesc: The usage table is empty — no API/MCP call has been recorded in this deployment yet.
empty.windowDesc: The table has data, but none in the selected window. Widen the window.
empty.filteredDesc: The window has data, but the actor-type filter excludes all of it. Clear the filter to see the window.

platform.stale: Refresh failed — showing the previous result.

project.label: Memory project
project.searchHint: Search filters the 100 projects loaded on this page; use pagination for the rest.
project.disabledUsage: usage disabled — needs all bindings readable or admin
project.emptyDesc: Usage is per memory project. Create or join one first.
project.notFoundDesc: This project does not exist, is soft-deleted, or is not visible to you.
project.selectDesc: Pick a project above to read its recorded Hument usage.

filters.modelHint: The model filter is an exact match on the requested OR resolved model. It is sent only when you apply the filters.
filters.windowHint: Absolute UTC [since, until). Maximum {max} days; both ends are required.

windowError.invalid: Both times must be valid timestamps.
windowError.order: The end time must be after the start time.
windowError.span: The window must not exceed 90 days.

permission.title: Usage is closed for this project
permission.desc: Usage is a project-level engine aggregate and cannot be filtered per source. It requires admin or read access on ALL of this project's bindings. Ask a binding owner to grant the remaining access, or ask an admin.

shared.title: Usage is disabled for this project
shared.desc: The engine identity is shared with another memory project, or its permanent ownership claim is missing / owned elsewhere. No engine call was made. An operator must audit the identity claim; self-service release is unavailable.

engine.projectUnboundDesc: Recorded model usage comes from the project's current Hument engine identity. Bind an engine before usage can be read.
engine.notConfiguredTitle: No memory engine on this deployment
engine.notConfiguredDesc: This deployment has no memory engine configured, so there is no engine usage to read.
engine.engineUnavailableDesc: The engine cannot be reached right now. Usage will be readable again once it answers; no numbers are shown to avoid guessing.

summary.stale: Refresh failed — showing the last successful snapshot ({asOf}). Retry for a fresh one.
summary.totalsNote: Totals cover the full matching set; trace page size does not change them.
summary.caveat: Model work recorded for the current binding/actor — not the project total or a complete bill. Unknown is not zero.
summary.ledgerScope: Hument engine usage ledger — not platform API/MCP calls.

cards.currencyNote: Micros are the raw unit recorded by the engine (one millionth of its cost unit). Currency is not declared; no conversion or USD assumption.
cards.duration: Physical duration: {physical} ms · known {known} ms · {unknown} unknown row(s)
cards.nonAddable: Actual and estimated are separate measures — do not add them together.

coverage.label: Coverage
coverage.excludedHint: Rows without a physical start time are excluded from a time-windowed total. This is not zero usage.

groups.title: Groups
groups.description: Top {shown} of {total} group(s) by operation, provider operation and model
groups.caption: Usage by operation, provider operation and model
groups.empty: No groups match this window and filter.

detail.nonAddable: Actual and estimated are separate — do not add them.

trace.title: Trace
trace.description: Lazy-loaded recorded usage rows for the same absolute window as the summary.
trace.resetting: The data snapshot changed — reloading the first page while keeping the rows below.
trace.emptyDesc: No usage rows match this window and filter.
trace.loadMoreError: This page failed to load — the rows below are kept.
trace.resetExhausted: The cursor was invalidated again after a reset
trace.resetExhaustedHint: Stopped to avoid a loop. Apply the filters again (or widen the window) to restart from page 1.
trace.caption: Recorded usage rows for the current window
trace.stale: Refresh failed — showing the previously loaded rows.
trace.disabledBlocked: Trace is closed while the summary is blocked by permissions, sharing, version or identity errors.
trace.disabledEmpty: Trace is disabled because the summary already shows this window/filter has no rows.

empty.filterDesc: The window has data, but the operation / provider operation / model filter excludes every row.
empty.allExcludedTitle: Every row was excluded for having no time
empty.allExcludedDesc: All matching evidence rows lack a physical start time, so a time-windowed total cannot include them. This is coverage debt, not zero usage.
empty.windowDesc: The engine recorded nothing for this project's current identity in the selected window.

error.versionTitle: The engine does not support usage yet
error.versionDesc: Upgrade the Hub to a version with the usage routes (alpha.19 or a contract-fix build). Retrying will not help.
error.dataTitle: The engine's data cannot be read
error.dataDesc: The Hub's existing ledger or receipts could not be interpreted (schema incompatible / conflicting evidence). This is a data issue, not a version issue. An operator must inspect the Hub data; do not retry blindly.
error.identityTitle: The engine identity is not authorized
error.identityDesc: The project's current binding is missing, ambiguous, or lacks inspect_read. Fix the project identity / binding grant; retrying and upgrading will not help.
error.unreachableDesc: The request never reached the engine. Check the project endpoint and retry later.
error.rateLimitedDesc: Wait for the Retry-After window, then retry the same request.
error.timeoutDesc: The request may still be running on the engine. Retry later; do not assume it failed.
error.networkDesc: The browser could not reach the platform. Check your connection and retry.
error.notFoundDesc: This project does not exist, is soft-deleted, or is not visible to you.
error.unauthorizedDesc: Your session is no longer valid. Sign in again.
error.genericDesc: The request failed. Retry; if it keeps failing, check the machine details.
